Dialog.Title: Import from Character Builder
Dialog.Intro: Choose a file saved by the Character Builder's Export or Backup & transfer button (daggerheart-characters-YYYY-MM-DD.json), or paste its contents.
Dialog.HomebrewHint: Characters that use homebrew content from the builder need that content in a compendium first.

Notifications.NoPermission: You need permission to create actors to import characters.

LogLevel.Name: Log level
LogLevel.Hint: How much the importer writes to the console.

Packs.Name: Compendium packs to search
Packs.Hint: Comma-separated pack ids, searched in order. Add homebrew packs here.

PortraitFolder.Name: Portrait upload folder
PortraitFolder.Hint: Where builder portraits are saved (under the user data folder).

AddStartingKit.Name: Add the class starting kit
AddStartingKit.Hint: Create the class's starting loot items (torch, rope, supplies) on import.

ActorFolder.Name: Actors folder for imports
ActorFolder.Hint: Name of the Actors-sidebar folder new imports go into (created if missing). Blank for no folder.

Homebrew.Title: Import homebrew source
Homebrew.Intro: Pick the JSON files of a builder homebrew source (the data/<source>/ folder: classes, subclasses, ancestries, communities, transformations, domain cards, items, weapons, armor, consumables, effects and source.json). Card art from card-art/ can be added too. The module creates a world compendium with everything as Foundry items, turns effects.json into active effects on the features and cards, registers new domains and custom weapon/armor features with the system's Homebrew settings, and searches that compendium when importing characters.
Homebrew.GMOnly: Only a GM can import homebrew sources.
Homebrew.FilesHint: Pick the source folder (e.g. data/void) to take its JSON files and card-art in one go, or pick files: JSON first, then the files inside card-art/domain and card-art/subclass. Selections accumulate; anything that is not a builder source file or image is ignored.
Homebrew.Existing: Sources already imported into this world
Homebrew.ReportDomains: New domains registered with the system's Homebrew settings: {domains}. Give them an icon there if you like.
Homebrew.ReportFeatures: Custom weapon/armor features registered with the system's Homebrew settings: {features}.
Homebrew.ReportNotes: Not automated (apply by hand on the sheet):
Homebrew.ReportIgnored: Ignored {file}: not a builder source file.
Homebrew.ReportNext: You can now import characters that use this content. Re-import the source after changing it in the builder; items keep their ids.
Homebrew.RemovePack: The compendium's documents are deleted, and the compendium itself once it is empty.
Homebrew.RemoveSetting: The compendium is dropped from this module's list of packs to search.
Homebrew.RemoveActors: Actors using this content keep their copied items, but lose the link to the compendium: {actors}.
Homebrew.RemoveDomains: Also remove what this import added to the system's Homebrew settings ({domains}). A domain that a card on an actor still uses is kept.
